$comment: Declared download list: every network destination the installer or a tool it drives contacts. The fresh-install capture gate (docs/NETWORK_GATE.md) fails on any destination not listed here. host is an exact name or a *.suffix pattern. gateRun: required = the guest run must observe it or the capture is invalid; expected = exercised by a default guest run; not-exercised = declared but the guest run cannot reach it (reported as declared-but-not-captured). source: code:<file>[, <file>] when the code names it (files, not line numbers, which go stale; the drift test checks each file exists), inferred when it comes from how the driven tool works. Add hosts only in a reviewed commit, never from a capture automatically.

browserLinks.$comment: Opened only when the user clicks, in the system browser (shell.openExternal). Never contacted by an unattended install. Must equal ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_HOSTS in src/lib/external-url.js; the drift test checks both that and every host literal in src/.
